_what: The safety nets of the decision store kept on this computer (src/local-store-safety.mjs). `snapshots_kept` rolling snapshots are written beside the store file in a folder named after it plus `folder_suffix`, no more often than every `min_interval_hours`. `before_change_kept` copies taken just before a change to the store's shape or a restore are kept the same way, in `before_folder_suffix`. `automatic` lets the store take a due snapshot each time it is opened. `shape_sources` are the source files (relative to src/) that define the store's tables; the BLAKE3 of their bytes is the store's shape, kept in the file's user_version. Opening a store whose kept shape differs from the code's first takes a copy before the change (src/local-store-safety.mjs guardShape).
